metadata.title: La Nuit | Appointments
metadata.description: Book and cancel appointments within enabled months.

home.title: Experience La Nuit, where service and ambiance are designed exclusively for you
home.subtitle: Don’t let time pass you by, and book your appointment before it’s too late!
home.languageHint: You can change the language at any time.
home.unavailableMessage: Agenda is currently unavailable. Contact us on WhatsApp for more information.

bookingPage.noSlotsDescription: No spots left for the active month.

bookingEntry.title: Book your {{month}} appointment
bookingEntry.description: Your beauty moment starts here. Reserve a personalized experience designed for your wellbeing.

booking.title: Book appointment
booking.slotLockedForYou: This slot is locked for you for {{time}}.
booking.welcomeBack: Hi {{name}}, great to have you back ✨
booking.name: Name
booking.rescheduleSelectionTitle: You already have active appointments in this month
booking.rescheduleSelectionSingle: Do you want to reschedule one of your active appointments this month?
booking.whatsappReminder: You'll receive two reminders via WhatsApp: one a week before and another one a day before your appointment.
booking.confirmSuccessBody: Your appointment has been successfully scheduled.
booking.pendingTitle: We're almost there; just one more step to go.
booking.pendingDescription:
Your appointment has already been pre-registered.
To finish scheduling your appointment, you need to send the deposit receipt via WhatsApp to reserve the spot.
Once we receive your receipt, we'll confirm your appointment.
booking.syncFailedInfo: Your booking was saved. Calendar sync will complete later.
booking.calendarHint: Tap a day to see available times

cancel.title: Cancel appointment
cancel.intro: To begin, enter your phone number.
cancel.confirmIntro: We found the following appointment linked to your phone number.
cancel.confirmIntroMultiple: We found future appointments linked to your phone number. Select one or more appointments to cancel.
cancel.confirmDetailsSubtitle: Below are the details of your appointment(s)
cancel.selectionRequired: Select at least one appointment to cancel.
cancel.importantBody: Please note that after cancellation, this slot will become available for someone else.
cancel.successInfo: Thank you for letting us know in advance. If you need to, you can book again in the available months.
cancel.name: Name
